classification.difficultyReason: Track two vehicles through different starts, a lunch stop and a fuel stop, construct an event table, determine a stationary passing event and round separate final arrivals; connected piecewise modelling with several dependent decisions.

inlines.text: At 7:30 a.m. a moving van (van 1) leaves Melbourne and heads for Mildura, 550 km away. At 10 a.m., another van (van 2) leaves Bendigo, 150 km from Melbourne on the Melbourne–Bendigo–Mildura road. It averages 90 km/h. Van 1 travels at an average speed of 80 km/h, but stops for lunch for an hour at Sea Lake, 360 km from Melbourne. Van 2 fills up at Ouyen, 100 km before Mildura. This takes 40 min.
Draw up a time/place table showing how far from Melbourne each van is at the times when they start, stop and pass each other. Then answer these questions.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How far ahead is van 1 when van 2 leaves Bendigo?

inlines.text: , while van 2 starts at 150 km. Thus the lead is

children.label: b
children.prompt: When and where does van 2 pass van 1?

answer.worked: Van 1 reaches Sea Lake at $7{:}30+\frac{360}{80}\text{ h}=12{:}00$ noon and stays until 1 p.m. Van 2 reaches 360 km at $10{:}00+\frac{(360-150)}{90}\text{ h}=12{:}20$ p.m., so it passes the stationary van 1 at Sea Lake.

children.label: c
children.prompt: When does van 2 leave Ouyen, and when it does, where is van 1?

answer.short: 2:00 p.m.; van 1 is 440 km from Melbourne.
answer.worked: Ouyen is $550-100=450\text{ km}$ from Melbourne. Van 2 reaches it at $10{:}00+\frac{(450-150)}{90}\text{ h}=1{:}20$ p.m. After 40 min it leaves at 2 p.m. Van 1 left Sea Lake at 1 p.m.; at 2 p.m. it is $360+80(1)=440\text{ km}$ from Melbourne.

children.label: d
children.prompt: At what time does each van reach Mildura, to the nearest minute?

answer.worked: Van 1 driving time is $\frac{550}{80}=6.875\text{ h}=6\text{ h }52\text{ min }30\text{ s}$. Add the 1 h lunch and 7:30 a.m. departure: arrival 3:22:30 p.m., rounding to 3:23 p.m. Van 2 drives 400 km in $\frac{400}{90}=4\frac49\text{ h}=4\text{ h }26\text{ min }40\text{ s}$. Add 40 min fuel and 10 a.m. departure: arrival 3:06:40 p.m., rounding to 3:07 p.m.
